title: Figures and Places
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 21 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Between June 8 and August 19, 2022, nearly every drawing was a mask. This room holds the twenty-one that were not. A figure with a balloon in a city, a man in a cage of red rain, a crow, a valley, a robot in the sun, a dog, a tree, a skeleton by a river. They were drawn in the gaps between the masks, sometimes on the same day.

They do not share a look. Some are a few lines on white. Some are painted. Some are as packed as the masks themselves, and two are crowds of masked figures standing together like a family photograph. What they share is that each one has a place in it: a street, a cage, a field, a fence, a sky.
Look for the horizon. The masks have none; they fill the square. Nearly everything here stands on a line, or under a sky, or beside a wall.

chapters.title: Figures in Places
chapters.opening: Six works from June 14 to 28. A figure in a patterned field, a figure with a balloon, a figure in ink, a man in a cage, a crow, and a valley.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #142
works.text: A red figure with spiral eyes and a grin stands in a field of yellow, green and purple pattern, a small black figure at its feet, white lines looping over everything.
works.caption: A tall red figure with spiral eyes grins in a field of colored bars, a small black figure at its feet.
works.reading: The figure is a tall red shape with a round head and short arms, drawn in red scribble with a black outline. The field behind it is made of vertical bars and squares in many colors. The small black figure at the lower right has a round white head. Recorded with 121 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #146
works.text: A black figure with a red face and a red chest walks through a pale city holding a red balloon on a long string. The buildings are a few thin lines, a tower, a fence, a window grid, and the sky is patches of blue and pink. The balloon has a small crown drawn on it. Fifty-four recorded strokes make the whole scene, and the figure, drawn in solid black with a thin red edge, is the one dark thing in it.
works.caption: A black figure with a red face walks through a pale city holding a red balloon on a long string.
works.reading: The face is a red circle with two white ringed eyes and a grin, and the red runs down the chest like a bib. The balloon string is a thin black line that wavers up to the balloon at the top right. A yellow line runs around the figure like a halo. The city is drawn in black line over washes of pink, blue and tan.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #148
works.text: A figure in black ink on white, seated with one leg out, its head a spiky skull with a grin, drawn in a few thick strokes and thin outlines.
works.caption: A figure in black ink on white, seated with one leg out, its spiky skull grinning.
works.reading: There is no color at all. The body is drawn in thick black strokes with white gaps between them, and a thin black outline runs around the whole figure. The skull has two hollow eyes and a row of teeth. A single line at the bottom is the ground. Twenty-nine strokes, the fewest in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #152
works.text: A figure with a crown stands inside a cage of red lines on black, under a roof of yellow and white. The lines fall from the roof like rain, and the figure behind them is drawn in white and yellow line with spiral eyes and a grin, its hands drawn in white at the bottom. Forty-four strokes, nearly all of them the red bars of the cage.
works.caption: A crowned figure stands inside a cage of red lines falling from a yellow roof, on black.
works.reading: The roof is a shallow triangle drawn in yellow, red and white with scribble inside. The red lines are drawn straight down from it at even spacing, and the figure is visible between them. The crown is a yellow zigzag. The black ground is flat.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #156
works.text: A crow with a red X eye and a red target on its wing stands on a perch in a storm of grey and black scribble, inside a grey frame.
works.caption: A crow with a red X eye and a red target on its wing perches in a storm of grey scribble.
works.reading: The crow is drawn in black and blue with a pointed beak and a crest. Its eye is a red X, and the red target on its wing is drawn in rings. The scribble around it is black and grey dashes in every direction. The perch is a black bar at the bottom. Recorded with 186 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #158
works.text: A valley. A blue river runs down between yellow hills, a green ridge rises at the right, and a pale sky of white and blue clouds is drawn over with thin black lines. Everything is scribbled in loops, the hills in yellow, the ridge in green, the river in blue, but the loops follow the land. It is the one open landscape in the mask months, drawn June 28, 2022.
works.caption: A blue river runs down between yellow hills, a green ridge at the right, pale clouds above.
works.reading: The river starts at the center and widens toward the lower left, drawn in blue loops with white inside. The hills are yellow scribble with orange at the edges. The sky is pale with cloud shapes outlined in black. Recorded with 100 strokes.

chapters.title: Crowds and a Robot
chapters.opening: July. A figure with a falling man, a maze of blocks, two crowds of masked figures, a robot in the sun, and a figure in the rain.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #169
works.text: A painted figure in purple and gold with a spiral eye looks up at a small figure tumbling in the pink above, drawn in loops of yellow and blue line.
works.caption: A painted figure in purple and gold with a spiral eye looks up at a small figure tumbling above.
works.reading: The large figure's face is painted in purple and brown with a yellow spiral for one eye and a small dark eye beside it. The tumbling figure at the upper right is drawn upside down in gold and blue. A yellow line loops around the whole square like a frame. Recorded with 159 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #177
works.text: A maze of colored blocks in black, red, blue and green, with yellow beads running through it and a tiny white figure with raised arms at the bottom.
works.caption: A maze of colored blocks with yellow beads running through it, a tiny white figure with raised arms below.
works.reading: The blocks are drawn as thick bars and squares, each filled with scribble, and the beads are yellow ovals strung between them. The white figure at the lower center has a spiral eye and a grin and stands with its arms up. A red cat shape sits at the top. Recorded with 137 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #182
works.text: A dark crowd. Masked figures stand together in red, black and gold scribble: a skull with a crown at the left, a round head with a beam at the top, a face with a wide mouth of teeth at the right, and a small figure with a pale face at the bottom. A pink flower sits at the upper left. The figures overlap, and no one has the whole square. It is the first of two crowds in the room, drawn July 10, with 257 strokes.
works.caption: A dark crowd of masked figures in red, black and gold scribble, a pink flower at the upper left.
works.reading: The skull at the left has a yellow crown and a grid of teeth. The head at the top has a spiral eye and a beam of gold rising from it. The face at the right has a mouth drawn as a box of white and yellow teeth. The small figure at the bottom has a pale face with dark eyes and a red body.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #183
works.text: The second crowd, nine days later. Four masked figures stand in a row, each with blue ringed eyes and a red mouth of white teeth, a black cat with X eyes beside them and a cat-eared figure at the upper left. The line is white and yellow over black and gold, and the figures are drawn more clearly than in the first crowd: each has a head, a body and a place in the row. Where the first crowd overlapped, this one lines up.
works.caption: Four masked figures in a row with blue ringed eyes and red toothy mouths, a black cat beside them.
works.reading: The figure at the center wears a white cap and has a mouth of white fangs. The cat at the lower right is solid black with two yellow X marks. The cat-eared figure at the upper left has a long face with a grin. A red knot at the lower left is another small head. Recorded with 132 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #186
works.text: A gold robot with two red ringed eyes and a grille of teeth stands in rays of yellow sun, its body built from boxes, a flower at the upper left.
works.caption: A gold robot with red ringed eyes and a grille of teeth stands in rays of yellow sun.
works.reading: The rays come from a point above the robot's head and spread over the whole square. The body is a stack of boxes drawn in white and gold line with scribble inside. The flower is drawn in pink and orange with a long stem. Recorded with 247 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #191
works.text: A figure in a gold hood stands in blue rain under a sun and a band of cloud, a yellow beam crossing it, its face a few dark marks in a glow.
works.caption: A figure in a gold hood stands in blue rain under a sun and a band of pink cloud.
works.reading: The rain is drawn as short vertical dashes of blue over a dark ground. The sun at the upper left is a yellow half disc with rays. The cloud is a band of blue and pink zigzag. The figure's face is a pale oval with two small eyes and a mouth. Recorded with 304 strokes.

chapters.title: A Dog, a Tree, a River
chapters.opening: July 31 to August 19. Two flat figures on one day, a skull in a summer shirt, a tree, and the last scenes of the mask months.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #212
works.text: A black dog stands on a black hill against pale blue, its mouth open, with short yellow wavy lines in a ring around it. Nothing is inside the black: no eye, no collar. It is the flat silhouette formula from the spring, drawn once more on July 31, 2022, in 49 strokes, in the middle of the mask months.
works.caption: A black dog stands on a black hill against pale blue, mouth open, yellow wavy lines around it.
works.reading: The dog faces left with its ears up and its tail raised, and the hill is a black slope cut by the bottom edge. The yellow lines are short and evenly spaced, standing out from the dog on all sides. The blue is flat.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #213
works.text: A figure with a sun for a head walks on black, its body a pink dress and its legs long yellow lines, with a ring of purple discs behind it like a flower.
works.caption: A figure with a sun for a head walks on black, in a pink dress, purple discs ringed behind it.
works.reading: The sun head is a gold disc with a small face and short rays. The dress is pink with a few folds drawn in darker pink. The legs are two long yellow lines bent at the knee. The purple discs overlap into a six-petal shape. Recorded with 101 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #214
works.text: A yellow skull with blue goggles and a red cap, a grin of grey teeth, in a white tee that says CCO SUMMER, on black scattered with white marks.
works.caption: A yellow skull in blue goggles and a red cap, grinning, in a white tee that says CCO SUMMER.
works.reading: The goggles are two blue boxes with pink and white eyes inside. The skull is drawn in yellow scribble with orange dots. The white marks on the black are short hooks and dashes drawn all around the head. The lettering is black on a white patch at the chest. Recorded with 328 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #219
works.text: A tree in full leaf, painted in hundreds of small dabs of yellow, green, pink and red, standing behind a fence in a yellow light that falls from the upper left. The trunk is a few dark strokes under the mass of leaves, and the grass at the bottom is small dabs too. With 1,758 recorded strokes it is the most worked drawing in the whole collection, and it is the one drawing in the mask months with no face in it at all.
works.caption: A tree in full leaf painted in hundreds of small colored dabs behind a fence in yellow light.
works.reading: The dabs are small ovals of color, each a separate stroke, piled until the tree is a cloud. The light is painted as soft yellow beams over the whole square. The fence is a row of dark posts along the bottom. A second tree stands at the upper right in darker tones.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #221
works.text: A yellow figure with a long striped neck curls around itself in a field of orange, pink and blue bars, its head at the upper left with a grin of teeth.
works.caption: A yellow figure with a long striped neck curls around itself in a field of colored bars.
works.reading: The neck is a thick tube drawn in gold with white stripes, and it loops from the head at the upper left down and around to the body at the center. The body is boxy with a grid of lines. The bars behind it run in every direction. Recorded with 222 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #225
works.text: A figure with long black hair over a blue body stands on brown, its face a yellow flower with two red X eyes and a grin of white teeth, small flowers at its feet.
works.caption: A long-haired figure in blue on brown, its face a yellow flower with red X eyes and white teeth.
works.reading: The hair is drawn in long black strokes with blue and white between them, falling to the ground. The flower face is a yellow ring of petals with a red X in each eye and a mouth of white blocks. Two small yellow flowers grow at the lower corners. Recorded with 110 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #228
works.text: A purple skull with green hair and two red spiral eyes grins on slate, with blue rays around its head and yellow beads at its neck.
works.caption: A purple skull with green hair and two red spiral eyes grins on slate, blue rays around its head.
works.reading: The skull is drawn in purple and blue with pink scribble, and the hair is a crest of green spikes. The spirals are red on white. The teeth are a wide grin of white triangles. The blue rays are short strokes at even spacing. Recorded with 167 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #232
works.caption: Gold bars and a red sun, four red discs down the middle, a yellow fence at the bottom, no figure.
works.reading: The bars are horizontal stripes of gold and brown with soft edges, and the sun is a red disc at the upper right. The four red discs are drawn with horizontal lines through them. The fence is a row of yellow posts at the bottom. Recorded with 144 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #233
works.text: A dense scene by a river: two white skeletons stand on a black mound at the upper left, a pink pig with a crown sits at the lower right, a yellow sun with a spiral at the center, and a black bridge with a yellow stripe crosses the top right. Red and blue lines loop over the whole picture. It is the last work of the mask months, drawn August 19, 2022, and the only one in the room with a crowd, a creature, a sun and water all together.
works.caption: Two white skeletons on a black mound, a pink crowned pig, a yellow sun and a bridge over a river.
works.reading: The skeletons are drawn in white line with X eyes, standing on a mound of black and yellow scribble. The pig has a spiral eye and a crown of spikes. The river is painted in blue with white loops, and the bridge is a black arc with a yellow zigzag along it. Recorded with 312 strokes.

closing: Look again at the figure with the balloon, walking through a city drawn in a few lines, and then at the scene by the river where everything is packed in at once. Both are places. The masks of the summer have no place at all, and that is why these twenty-one hang together.
